Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a NEW collection of four isolated game power-up icons. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the soft rounded toy/clay materials, gentle highlights and cheerful storybook feeling of these game pieces. Do not copy the six reference objects.
Composition: exactly 1024x1024 square, invisible 2-column by 2-row grid, one icon per 512x512 cell, centered at (256,256), (768,256), (256,768), (768,768). Each complete icon fits within a centered 350x350 box. All four have equal apparent visual mass. Front view with a subtle shared top-left view, lighting from upper left. Readable at 36 pixels.
Style: premium softly sculpted 3D mobile puzzle game sprites. Chunky, pillowy, smooth clay/enamel, broad clean highlights, warm cream, cornflower blue, lilac and buttery yellow, with small bright accents. Rich cheerful colours, not pale washed-out objects. No thin metallic outlines, realistic textures, faces, eyes or micro-details.
Background: real transparent RGBA PNG with fully transparent empty space outside the icons. No backdrop, gradients, drop shadows, floor, pedestal, border, checkerboard or glow outside the objects. Crisp antialiased silhouettes, self shading only on objects.

Four icons, reading order:
TOP LEFT: a plump cornflower-blue hexagonal medallion with a thick raised buttery-yellow PLUS symbol, simple cream bevel around the edge. No numerals.
TOP RIGHT: a friendly cream-white padded royal glove with a short blue cuff; hand upright, index finger pointing upward and thumb visible, three other fingers folded. Clearly a hand, not a character.
BOTTOM LEFT: a toy royal mallet, thick buttery-yellow rounded rectangular hammer head and a short lilac handle, tilted diagonally, simple cream inset on hammer head. No symbols.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a chunky magical paintbrush with a short golden-yellow handle, lilac ferrule and a broad brush tip divided into four large colourful rounded bristle sections: pink, sky blue, green, yellow. Diagonal orientation. This means recolour nearby pieces.
Exactly these four objects. No labels, words, numerals, additional decorations or other objects.
